## Great Wyrm River Dragon (CR 19)

**XP** 204,800  
 CN Gargantuan Dragon (aquatic, fire)  
 **Init** +3; **Senses** dragon senses, watersight; Perception +40; **Aura** boiling (10 ft., 2d6 fire), frightful presence (360 ft., DC 29)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 42, touch 5, flat-footed 42 (-1 Dex, +37 natural, -4 size)  
 **hp** 546 (26d12+234)  
 **Fort** +23, **Ref** +16, **Will** +22  
 **DR** 20/magic; **Immune** fire, dragon traits; **SR** 30  
 **Weaknesses** vulnerabilty to cold  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft., swim 60 ft.  
 **Melee** bite +36 (4d6+19), tail +35 (2d8+19)  
 **Space** 20 ft.; **Reach** 15 ft. (20 ft. with bite)  
 **Special Attacks** breath weapon (120-ft. line, DC 31, 24d6 fire), geyser, spit (60 ft)  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 26th; concentration +32)  

  
  At will—
  *[control water](../../magic/spells/control-water.md)*,
  *[obscuring mist](../../magic/spells/obscuring-mist.md)*,
  *[overland flight](../../magic/spells/overland-flight.md)*,
  *[passwall](../../magic/spells/passwall.md)*,
  *[soften earth and stone](../../magic/spells/soften-earth-and-stone.md)*,
  *[water breathing](../../magic/spells/water-breathing.md)*
  

  
 **Sorcerer Spells Known** (CL 17th; concentration +23)  

  
  8th (4/day)—
  *[telekinetic sphere](../../magic/spells/telekinetic-sphere.md)* (DC 23),
  *[screen](../../magic/spells/screen.md)* (DC 23)
  

  7th (6/day)—
  *[power word blind](../../magic/spells/power-word-blind.md)*,
  *[spell turning](../../magic/spells/spell-turning.md)*,
  *[vortex](../../magic/spells/vortex.md)*
   (DC 22)
  

  6th (7/day)—
  *[antimagic field](../../magic/spells/antimagic-field.md)*,
  *[move earth](../../magic/spells/move-earth.md)*,
  *[contagious flame](../../magic/spells/contagious-flame.md)*
  
  

  5th (7/day)—baleful
  *[polymorph](../../magic/spells/polymorph.md)* (DC 21),
  *[mind fog](../../magic/spells/mind-fog.md)* (DC 21),
  *[transmute rock to mud](../../magic/spells/transmute-rock-to-mud.md)*,
  *[suffocation](../../magic/spells/suffocation.md)*
   (DC 21)
  

  4th (7/day)—
  *[fire shield](../../magic/spells/fire-shield.md)*,
  *[hallucinatory terrain](../../magic/spells/hallucinatory-terrain.md)* (DC 20),
  *[solid fog](../../magic/spells/solid-fog.md)*,
  *[wall of fire](../../magic/spells/wall-of-fire.md)* (DC 20)
  

  3rd (7/day)—
  *[dispel magic](../../magic/spells/dispel-magic.md)*,
  *[fireball](../../magic/spells/fireball.md)* (DC 19),
  *[gaseous form](../../magic/spells/gaseous-form.md)*,
  *[haste](../../magic/spells/haste.md)*
  

  2nd (8/day)—
  *[blur](../../magic/spells/blur.md)*,
  *[cat’s grace](../../magic/spells/cats-grace.md)*,
  *[hideous laughter](../../magic/spells/hideous-laughter.md)* (DC 18),
  *[pyrotechnics](../../magic/spells/pyrotechnics.md)* (DC 18),
  *[resist energy](../../magic/spells/resist-energy.md)*
  

  1st (8/day)—
  *[color spray](../../magic/spells/color-spray.md)* (DC 17),
  *[expeditious retreat](../../magic/spells/expeditious-retreat.md)*,
  *[identify](../../magic/spells/identify.md)*,
  *[magic missile](../../magic/spells/magic-missile.md)*,
  *[reduce person](../../magic/spells/reduce-person.md)*
  

  0 (at will)—
  *[arcane mark](../../magic/spells/arcane-mark.md)*,
  *[detect magic](../../magic/spells/detect-magic.md)*,
  *[flare](../../magic/spells/flare.md)*,
  *[ghost sound](../../magic/spells/ghost-sound.md)*,
  *[mage hand](../../magic/spells/mage-hand.md)*,
  *[message](../../magic/spells/message.md)*,
  *[prestidigitation](../../magic/spells/prestidigitation.md)*,
  *[read magic](../../magic/spells/read-magic.md)*,
  *[resistance](../../magic/spells/resistance.md)*
  

  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 37, **Dex** 9, **Con** 26, **Int** 21, **Wis** 24, **Cha** 22  
 **Base Atk** +26; **CMB** +42; **CMD** 51  
 **Feats** Alertness, Arcane Strike, Athletic, Awesome Blow, Cleave, Great Cleave, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Lunge, Snatch, Weapon Focus (bite), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Toughness.*  
 **Skills** Appraise +34, Diplomacy +35, Intimidate +35, Linguistics +34, Knowledge (nature) +34, Perception +40, Sense Motive +40, Spellcraft +34, Stealth +16, Survival, +36, Swim +54; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Swim  
 **Languages** Aquan, Common, Draconic, Ignan, Sylvan and 34 others  
 **SQ** air breathing, speak with aquatic, watersight  

**Special Abilities**

 **Air Breathing (Ex)**  The river dragon can breathe air just as naturally as water. This dragon can freely use its breath weapon, spells and other abilities in both air and water.  

 **Boiling Aura (Su)**  This river dragon radiates heat causing any water around it to boil. All creatures within 10 ft. of the dragon take 2d6 points of fire damage at the beginning of the dragon’s turn. The river dragon can suppress or activate this ability at will as a free action.  

 **Geyser (Su)**  The river dragon can call forth a powerful geyser from the ground as a standard action. The geyser is 10 ft. wide burst within 400 ft. of the river dragon. All creatures standing in the geyser’s space takes 4d6 points of fire damage per round from the scalding hot water and are distracted. All other creatures within 200 ft. of the geyser take 2d6 points of fire damage per round in addition to the normal rain penalties.  

 **Speak with Aquatic (Ex)**  This river dragon has a constant spell-like ability to speak with animals of the aquatic subtype. This otherwise functions as *speak with animals**.*  

 **Spit (Ex)**  This river dragon has the ability to spit water at any target within 60 ft. as a ranged overrun attempt. The CMB check for the spit is the river dragon’s CMB but is one size category smaller than the river dragon and gains the benefits of the Improved Overrun feat. This does not grant the river dragon the benefits of the Improved Overrun feat when making a overrun attempt and not spitting.  

 **Watersight (Ex)**  This river dragon can see underwater four times better than a human.

**Ecology**

 **Environment** temperate aquatic
